title: Please, Thanks and Softening
focus: Reformular pedidos com suavizadores para diferentes graus de formalidade
verifiableTask: Reformular quatro pedidos para diferentes graus de formalidade

content.text: Ao final da aula você consegue:
fazer o mesmo pedido em vários níveis de formalidade e escolher o mais adequado.
reformular quatro pedidos para diferentes graus de formalidade.
e abra uma conversa com question tag.
How do you ask for a favour politely in Portuguese? (
Do you think direct requests sound rude in English?
Could you open the window, please?
Could you possibly open the window?
Would you mind opening the window?
I was wondering if you could open the window.
I don't suppose you could open the window, could you?
Could I just ask a quick question?
It's a bit cold in here.
Have you got a quick minute?
It's a bit cold in here…

questions.questionText: Which request is the most indirect?

options.text: I don't suppose you could help me, could you?

explanations.general: Correct answer: I don't suppose you could help me, could you?
Could you possibly open the window?

questions.questionText: “Would you mind closing the door?” — You will close it. You say…
“It's a bit cold in here…” might be…

options.text: an indirect request to close the window

explanations.general: Correct answer: an indirect request to close the window

content.text: 3.1 Troque e fale: suba o nível
O professor diz o pedido direto; o aluno sobe 2 níveis:
Could you send me the file, please?
I was wondering if you could send me the file.
I can't quite see the screen from here.

questions.questionText: Would you mind ______ me with this box? (help)

explanations.general: Would you mind helping me with this box?

questions.questionText: “Gosh, these boxes are heavy…” is probably…

explanations.general: Correct answer: an indirect request for help

questions.questionText: Could I ______ ask a quick question? (só — suavizador)

explanations.general: Could I just ask a quick question?

questions.questionText: ______ we could start a bit earlier? (talvez — p…)

explanations.general: Perhaps we could start a bit earlier?

questions.questionText: “Thanks ever so much” is a warm, polite way to say thank you.

content.text: Para cada um, o aluno faz o pedido no nível certo; o professor responde (às vezes recusando).
sair uma hora mais cedo na quinta.
reformule cada pedido em mais um nível (mais ou menos formal) e explique por que o primeiro era o mais adequado.
[ ] Ajustou o pedido à pessoa e à situação?
Escreva 4 pedidos nos 6 níveis da aula.
just, a bit, quick, possibly, perhaps
Grave os níveis 3, 4 e 6 com entonação educada (ouça antes exemplos com sotaque britânico).
Escreva 5 frases indiretas que funcionam como pedido.
Escreva o diálogo do pedido 4 (8–10 linhas).
Grave 60–90 s fazendo os 4 pedidos da tarefa.

questions.questionText: Which is natural with a close friend?

options.text: Can you lend me a tenner?
I was wondering if you could possibly consider lending me a ten-pound note.

explanations.general: Correct answer: Can you lend me a tenner?

questions.questionText: I was ______ if you could help me. (me perguntando)

explanations.general: I was wondering if you could help me.
Have you got a quick minute?

questions.questionText: Softeners like “just” and “a bit” make requests sound less direct.
